## 2. Disciplinary Proceedings  
[ Swamy's -  
CCS (CCA) Rules]  
The procedure to be followed in disciplinary cases against Government  
servants is laid down in detail in the CCS (CCA) Rules.  
1. Penalties.The following are the penalties that may be imposed on a Government servant:-  
Minor Penalties.  
- (i)
- Censure;
- (ii)
- (iii)
- Withholding of promotions;
- Recovery from pay of the whole or part of any pecuniary loss to Government caused by the official's negligence or breach of orders;
